pages.title: Key-Value Pairs
pages.content: Dictionaries store data in key-value pairs using curly braces `{}`. Each key must be unique. You access values by their key, not by index. Dictionaries are very fast for lookups.

pages.title: Working with Dicts
pages.code:
person = {
    "name": "Alice",
    "age": 25,
    "city": "Paris"
}

print(person["name"])   # Alice
print(person["age"])    # 25

# Add / update
person["email"] = "alice@mail.com"
person["age"] = 26

print(person)

pages.title: Quick Check
pages.question: How do you access a value in a dictionary?
pages.explanation: Use the key inside square brackets to access the corresponding value.
